beats.speaker: tyrol
beats.text: Not a scratch. I'm almost disappointed.

beats.speaker: tyrol
beats.text: Patching what I can. Give me the thirty-three.

beats.speaker: tigh
beats.text: Vipers held. Barely counts as good news.

beats.speaker: tyrol
beats.text: This is not patching. This is prayer.

beats.speaker: adama
beats.text: Do what you can, Chief. That's all I ask.

beats.speaker: gaeta
beats.text: Sure hope you count right, Starbuck.
